description: A subscription is a way to listen to events

id.description: The unique identifier for the subscription

context.description: Structured filter criteria for granular device event matching. Keys are dot-notation paths into the message (e.g., "header.namespace", "header.name"). Values are the expected values to match. All context entries must match for the subscription to fire. Omitting context matches all events.

status.description: Event monitor lifecycle. Legacy subscriptions may omit this field.

reasonCode.description: Redacted stable lifecycle reason, when applicable.

eventQueryProfile.description: Supported typed event query validation profile, when this is an event monitor.
